FEES ACT 1951

FEES (NATIONAL PLANETARIUM) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2011

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Fees Act 1951 [Act 209], the

Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Fees (National Planetarium)

(Amendment) Order 2011.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 January 2012.

Amendment of Schedule

2. The Fees (National Planetarium) Order 1997 [P.U. (A) 461/1997] is amended by
